author: PokerFace
body:
I think I suggested this before, but it would be nice if all the information for a previous tournament was consolidated in one post and wasn't archived. I was just trying to see how teams placed, but I can't even find the rankings anywhere. Most of the links on the competitive page do not work as well, and I don't understand why the spreadsheet for Avicus League was deleted/hidden.

And when there is a tournament in progress, the multiple posts addressing different things is fine, but right after it finishes, I think it should be compiled in one post. Also, if you could say who the winner of the tournament was at the bottom, that would be great.
